notes: H-arm is measured from the aircraft nose datum, in metres, the same datum as index-formula.json refSta (33.1555).
The zones tile the main deck without gaps: every zone's rear H-arm equals the next zone's front H-arm.
Zone pitch is 2.261 m (89 in) from B to R, 2.235 m for A, and 2.667 / 2.464 m for the tapering aft zones R..U.

These are the seventeen main-deck LOADING ZONES A..U shared by the cargo index, LMC index and lateral imbalance tables. They are NOT the combined-load zones ZA..ZU in combined-load.json, which carry their own hArm values.
